name: Intracellular Ca2+-release channel survey
description: ITPR and RYR across the tree-of-life panel. The grandparent project (../ip3r_genes) is a full census of the IP3 receptors, so anything this returns for ITPR has an external check available - and must never be seeded from it (port the method, never the result). Watch the length band: 2,000-5,100 aa spans the two largest families in the catalogue, and a size filter tuned for one excludes the other.
